blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—Ateneo got its first win in the UAAP Season 89 women’s basketball tournament after beating rival La Salle, 79-66, at Mall of Asia Arena on Wednesday. The Blue Eagles improved to 1-2, dropping the Green Archers to the same record. “I’m very happy that we got our first win today. We just remembered what coach PJ (Navarro) said, which was, we can lose to everyone, just not La Salle,” said Ateneo star Kacey Dela Rosa.
